# Security policy

Do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.

Use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this repository and include:

- the affected surface and potential impact,
- the smallest safe reproduction,
- affected versions or commits when known,
- suggested mitigation when available.

Do not include real credentials, session cookies, private player data, or destructive proof-of-concept activity. You will receive an acknowledgement through the private advisory when the report has been reviewed.
